$comment: Time-limited acceptances for dependency advisories that ops/ci/audit.mjs would otherwise fail on.
An entry is a decision, not a mute: it needs a real reason, a named owner, and an expiry date.
The gate fails when an entry expires, so every acceptance comes back for review on a known day.
maxAcceptanceDays caps how far out expires_on may be, so nothing can be accepted indefinitely.
Remove an entry as soon as the advisory is gone from the lockfile — the gate warns about leftovers.
